nativeImage.instrument: Cassini Imaging Science Subsystem narrow-angle camera, visible light

nativeImage.captionMeasurements: About 370000 km spacecraft range and 2 km/pixel are caption estimates, not new raster calculations.
nativeImage.processing: Original served JPEG bytes retained unchanged; distinct dynamic rendition is publisher re-encoding, not byte/pixel identity. Neither embedded.
nativeImage.newestScope: NASA calls this Cassini final Rhea observation; no exhaustive newest observation across all instruments claimed.

nativeSurface.limitations: Underlying product association, coverage, coordinate frame, input epochs and photometry open. Exact bytes do not establish calibrated geography/colour.

science.measured: NASA overview reports Cassini detection of tenuous oxygen/carbon-dioxide exosphere in 2010; do not label Rhea strictly without gas.
science.modelled: Sputtering/radiolysis and bulk ice/rock or canyon evolution interpretations do not measure local chemistry fractions or observer-visible haze/clouds.

rings.assessment: Primary abstract reports no imaging evidence for orbiting material and rejects the earlier ring explanation for charged-particle absorptions. Do not depict a confirmed Rhea ring.
rings.accessScope: Abstract read; full paper/figures not downloaded or audited, no source hash or CC licence asserted.

science.unknown: Local chemical fractions, material colour, surface registration, full primary exosphere parameters and recent full-paper audit remain open.

budget.interpretation: Original raw JPEG alone exceeds prior headroom before illustration/text overhead; exact build cost and further lossless recovery or credited publisher rendition assessment needed before embedding.
